criteria.name: Thumb-stop cover
criteria.notes: At the 432 px thumb the 11-word headline is huge and reads in three lines, and the tension is real (AI forecasts against a map with holes). But it has no number, place or name. Halong is in the kicker only. Nothing in the art depicts a hole: the hollow Delta cell is a thin wire box that competes with the extruded slab and does not read as missing. The landmass reads as coastline but not clearly as Western Alaska or the Bering Strait from this oblique, because the slab walls look like cut card. Strong but slightly abstract, so the 7 band, top end.

criteria.name: Story arc & swipe momentum
criteria.notes: Clear beats: mechanism, holes, storm, water, legend, breather, both poles, ask. The 03-04 and 04-05 seams pull hard, and the round 5 'A YEAR AGO' kicker fixes the flashback. The flow critic still rates 02-03, 05-06, 06-07 and 07-08 as weak junctions. 02 explains the mechanism but does not pay the cover's 'holes', which arrive on 03. 07 and 08 could swap with little loss. The contact sheet reads as one composed sequence.

criteria.name: Artwork craft & genuine detail
criteria.notes: Real highs. 05 is a GPU PBR flood with a reflected break, fog and lit grass at the wrack line, a genuine masterful depth frame. 04's streamline vortex is excellent. 02's strata block with DEM lakes and six gold marks is good, and 08's lathe-ring globe has a soft terminator. 01 climbs the rendered ladder. Held down by: 06's tray, a uniform flat waffle panel whose lids and walls are invisible at thumb, with dead dark bands below and right of it; 07's crest ribbons at near-constant width, reading as op-art stripes; 01's extrusion walls, uniform cardboard thickness with flat olive interior lowlands; 09's slab, soft and muddy, with ghost relief blobs in the fog behind the quote; and 05's tussock tops, floating pancake discs in regular rows, with the cell's reflection drawn as a second box in a different perspective. Several strong frames, several defaults, so solidly 7 band.

criteria.name: Story-art fusion
criteria.notes: Art parameters encode the story. On 02, six gold marks stand for the six C39 observation types. On 03, a 100-tick neatline has 15 ticks not solid (C55, asserted 100/100 and 15/15). On 06, 1,000 cells with 3 gold encode 0.3% (C29). On 05, the dimension call spans the drawn sheet for 'more than 15 mi'. 04 draws the dashed forecast path against the hook east. The Delta cell motif threads every frame. A stranger would guess 'weather forecasting and observations over coastal Alaska'. 01, 07 and 09 carry no encoding, and the cover never draws the 'holes'.

criteria.name: Alaska authenticity & local relevance
criteria.notes: Kipnuk, Kotzebue (PAOT), the Y-K Delta region drawn from the Bethel and Kusilvak census areas, Kuskokwim Bay, Norton Sound, Nelson and Nunivak islands in the true-projection DEM, Rick Thoman, KYUK, and Halong's date. No station dots are invented at villages and no buildings are invented. 08 widens to both poles but stays anchored at the Bering Strait. Would make a Delta resident feel seen.

criteria.name: Insight density & factual weight
criteria.notes: Each content frame adds a new verified specific: 02 the GDAS mechanism and observation types; 03 the 'since April' outages, the Kotzebue suspension and 10-15 per 100; 04 track against shift plus the December 17th guard; 05 the 15 mi, 1,500 people and Kipnuk's 90%; 06 the 40 minutes, 0.3%, the v1.0 degradation and the 160 promised with no sites named; 08 the Eos decade-to-dozens point and 1978. The round-5 trim removed 06's repeats of 03. 07 is a deliberate breather.

criteria.name: Variety vs ledger
criteria.notes: New hero, atmosphere, palette (silt, stratus, sedge rust), type pairing (Bricolage plus JetBrains Mono plus Instrument Serif water names), hook (the blank on the map) and dials, all justified in the storyboard. Still, DEM hillshade Alaska maps and a camera-altitude continuity are well-worn house subsystems, so it is not fully divergent.

criteria.name: Legibility & platform fitness
criteria.notes: Body type is 33-35 px and headlines are huge. Counters are on every frame, and the PDF is vector, 13.58 MB, titled. But 38 qa warns include a long run of 19-22 px fact-bearing labels. 03's C55 line, '10 TO 15 OF EVERY 100...', is an 18 px rotated decorative label, and since 06 dropped that row it is the only place the fact appears; it needs full-size viewing. Other undersized labels: 04's December 17th guard (22 px), 05's 'MORE THAN 15 MI' (22 px), 08's 1978 label (20 px), 02's six observation labels (20 px). The 01 leader label has a worst-point contrast of 4.2. 05 and 08 have hanging-preposition display breaks ('than', 'not').

criteria.name: Copy: voice & hook
criteria.notes: The hook is 132 characters, a two-sentence contradiction. Total 889 characters, comma rate 0.83 per 100 words. The position line 'A faster model can't fill in a reading nobody took.' takes a stance. The deck-summary line is present and the closing trust question is debatable. One soft spot: 'NOAA fine-tuned that AI model on a grid of surface, balloon and satellite observations' compresses C34 and C38 (GDAS analyses are not literally a grid of raw observations).

one_sentence_fix: Bring every fact-bearing label to the 24 px floor and onto the reading axis: set 03's C55 neatline line horizontally at 24 px or larger under the body, and raise 04's December 17th guard, 05's 'MORE THAN 15 MI', 02's six observation labels and 08's 1978 record label to 24 px.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The largest object, the 1,000-cell compute tray, reads as a flat uniform dark waffle. Lit lids and dark side walls are invisible at thumb, the tray is a near-frontal rectangle with a hairline side face, and there are dead dark bands below it (y about 1700 to 1900 of 2000) and to its right around the label.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Re-project the tray as a true oblique or three-quarter cabinet with a visibly lit top-face gradient and a darker, deeper front wall. Group the cells in 10x10 blocks with bevelled gutters so the scale reads, and enlarge and lower the tray to fill the lower third so the dead band goes.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The engraved swell is near-constant-width white ribbons with regular spacing. It reads as op-art stripes rather than lit crests and lee troughs, and the glint wedge under the break barely registers.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drive stroke width by Lambert against the west key (hairline in the lee, swelling on windward faces), break crests into broken segments with occasional whitecap flecks, and confine the bright ink to a glint path that widens toward the viewer.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The hero slab's extrusion walls are a uniform cardboard thickness all round the coast, so the land reads as cut card. The Delta lowlands are flat olive with no thaw-lake texture, and the Bering Strait and Western Alaska geography is hard to read from this oblique. The hollow cell floats over open sea and does not read as a hole.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Cut the wall height to a thin bevelled shelf with a graded shelf-sea tone. Bring the full-resolution Delta DEM lakes in, tinted with the stratus as on 09. Pull the camera so the Bering Strait sits visibly at the top of the slab, and seat the cell on the Delta coast with the lattice around it.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The Delta slab is soft and muddy at full size, with an olive interior and little modelling. Ghost relief blobs show through the fog in the upper right behind the quote, so the top half reads as smudge rather than deliberate fog.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Remove the residual focus blur on the slab top, deepen the west-bevel highlight and east lee, and fade the upper relief fully into a clean stratus gradient above y 900 so the ask sits on clean ground.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The tussock tops on the flood render as identical flat dark pancake discs in near-regular rows. The Delta cell's reflection is drawn as a second box with its own perspective (top face visible) instead of a mirrored, rippled image.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Vary tussock size, outline and height, give each a lit west rim and a short reflection, and redraw the cell's reflection as a true vertical mirror at lower alpha, broken by the water's ripple.
